dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.3: §4§l§o<Apiglo>§c These brave warriors want to kill me and take my treasure!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.4: §4§l§o<Apiglo>§c They're going to face the emperor! Their... emperor.
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.5: §4§l§o<Apiglo>§c What shall we do? I'm deeply afraid...
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.6: §4§l§o<Apiglo>§c Do we beg for mercy? Beg for our lives?
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.7: §4§l§o<Apiglo>§c What do you think, my loyal blade?
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.8: §6§l§o<Glaivorus>§e I think we can split them in half!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.9: §6§l§o<Glaivorus>§e Paint the walls with their blood!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.10: §6§l§o<Glaivorus>§e Gut them! Pierce them! Slay them!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.11: §6§l§o<Glaivorus>§e I picture them begging for mercy among their mournful cries...
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.12: §4§l§o<Apiglo>§c I quite like your idea, Glaivorus.
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.13: §4§l§o<Apiglo>§c And you? What do you think?
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.intro.14: §4§l§o<Apiglo>§c Come close, then... If you dare.
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.1.2: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c Let the knights attack and end these intruders!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.1.3: §6§o§l<Glaivorus>§e But... I wanted to do it, my emperor!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.1.4: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c Calm down, Glaivorus, and enjoy the view from up here.
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.2.1: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c Glaivorus! Show these insolent intruders why I'm the emperor!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.2.3: §6§o§l<Glaivorus>§e It shall be a pleasure to listen their screams of agony when I cut their innards out!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.3.1: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c It's clear that if you want to do something...
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.3.2: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c You have to do it yourself!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.4.3: §6§o§l<Glaivorus>§e I will spread their guts on the floor!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.5.5: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c Servants! You better end them right now!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.6.2: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c I will end you here and now!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.6.3: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c Glaivorus... Don't you dare fail me now.
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.7.1: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c Glaivorus you are USELESS! Why are they still alive?!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.7.2: §6§o§l<Glaivorus>§e It is you who are nothing without MY power.
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.7.3: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c How dare you say such a thing! I am the EMPEROR!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.7.4: §6§o§l<Glaivorus>§e You don't need me? Very well, I'll leave them to you!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.7.5: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c No... NO! Glaivorus, come back! I COMMAND you!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.8.3: §4§o§l<Apliglo>§c I can grant you unthinkable power if you let me live!
dialogue.finalparadox.apiglo.set.8.4: <Koros> End him! Without his blade, he's completely defenseless.

message.finalparadox.apiglo.guide.main: First of all, you no longer need to stay close to a §dHoly Pig§f. Second, I can help you beat this fight.

message.finalparadox.apiglo.guide.briefi: Apiglo is an arrogant tyrant who has ruled these lands for centuries. He received his powerful enchanted runeblade, Glaivorus, from a mysterious being in exchange for protecting the Pink Core with his life. With the power the sword granted him, he proclaimed himself the emperor, and is willing to end anyone who opposes his monarchy.
message.finalparadox.apiglo.guide.mechan: For this battle, you'll need area of effect damage and good mobility. The fight contains 3 phases and 2 interphases. These are all of Apiglo's abilities, put your mouse over them to see them in detail.
message.finalparadox.apiglo.guide.abilit:
§e§lFall of Glaivorus

§fUnder a random player, several
marks §cof red§f particles in a circle shape
will appear. Soon after, Glaivorus will drop
§ca rain of harmful§f daggers over those marks.

§6§lButcher§f

For some seconds, Glaivorus summons
§cmassive blades§f towards the players
that move wildly through the area. The
blades will appear progressively §cfaster§f.

§b§lStrategic Advice§f

The trajectory of the blades is marked
with a§c red line§f on the floor. ¡§eFocus
on avoidance§f while during §6Butcher§f,
as the blades deal§e massive damage§f.!

§c§lBlades of Torment§c ☠§f

Glaivorus summons on the floor §ba blue area with a falling§f
sword for each player fighting. There must be a
player in each §barea§f in the moment §cthat
the sword touches the ground§f to absorb its power and
obtain strength and regeneration. Otherwise, if there are
§bno players§f in an area, it will explode dealing §cdamage§f
to all players.

At first, when failing at the mechanic, this will not deal much
damage, but if §cyou fail too many times§f, it will
start dealing §clethal damage§f..

§e§lSummon Servants§f

Periodically, Apiglo summons servants
to help him.

§e§lDespair§f

Upon reaching the §clast phase§f (phase 3), Apiglo
will enrage, increasing
his speed and damage.

§c§lRoyal Stampede§c ☠§f

Apiglo orders his hoglin army to attack,
forming a line on§c two sides§f of the room. There will
§cbe a safe spot in each§f of the two sides. 
Players must place themselves accordingly in order to not be
hit at when the hoglins charge towards the
opposite side of the room, otherwise taking §clethal
damage§f.

§7§o(The first two times, the safe spot
will be marked with white particles)

§e§lSummon Elite Servants§f

During the Interphase Apiglo will summon
elite servants to aid him.
There are two kinds:

§eImperial Archer§f: Skeleton with high Punch on
its bow.

§eImperial Despot§f: Piglin Brute.

subtitle.finalparadox.thar_kroo.victory: §f§lThar Kroo has entrusted you with his gift.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.defeat.1: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Koros... we have failed again. The universe is doomed... because of me.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.2: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c I've been waiting for a long time.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.3: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c And now you shall know the truth...
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.5: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Or at least, I used to be.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.6: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Years ago, my home world was conquered and nearly all of my species were killed.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.7: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c That very day I swore revenge.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.8: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c I would conquer and bring peace to this galaxy so no one would suffer as we did.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.9: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c My methods were detestable. I believed the end would justify the means.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.10: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Invasions, Blackfire... Yet the worst came later.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.11: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c I stole Eothar's knowledge, dominated Aphofis and gathered the Cosmic Cores to travel through time.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.12: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c With that power I became invincible and took my revenge.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.13: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c I unified the galaxy and obtained peace... or so I thought.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.14: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c In time I saw that my prosperous society was a ruthless empire.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.15: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c And in the end... I annihilated everything.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.16: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Full of regret, I traveled into the past seeking heroes who could right my wrongs.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.18: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c You must stop my younger self before he dominates Aphofis and completes his first journey through time.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.19: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Otherwise, it will be too late.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.intro.22: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Prove you are strong enough to receive my power!
§4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Prove that I am not wrong about you!
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.finale.2: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c You have surpassed all my challenges.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.finale.3: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c I know you're worthy, and I trust you with the future of the galaxy.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.finale.4: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Complete the monument with the Cosmic Cores, then travel to Paradox Citadel.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.finale.5: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c You will be on his territory, and I... cannot come with you.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.finale.6: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c He can dominate your minds, so I shall grant you a fragment of myself to resist him.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.finale.7: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c In the name of peace, may my sacrifice not be in vain!
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.finale.8: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c I hope all the lives I destroyed can forgive me.
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.finale.9: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Koros... you have guided them here...
dialogue.finalparadox.thar_kroo.finale.1: §4§o§l<Thar Kroo>§c Guide them toward a better future.
I will not misunderstand you... Creator.

message.finalparadox.koros.guide.instruc: §8§o      Please §3§oclick§8§o one of the interactions in the chat.
message.finalparadox.koros.guide.briefin: Gariheuz and Koyomi are two galactic bountyhunters that, much like you, seek the cyan core. Since all of you arrived at the same time, you'll have to earn it in a battle.

message.finalparadox.koros.guide.ability:
§e§lArcane Shield§r

Koyomi and Gariheuz will take turns using a magic shield
based on their hp. The shield makes them invulnerable, and
reflects all damage taken.

§b§lStrategic tip:§r

1º Never attack whoever has the shield!

§e§lConfidence in Battle§r

Gariheuz becomes confident fighting alone, and
Koyomi becomes confident fighting near Gariheuz. While
they're confident they take 80% less damage
and they're faster.

§b§lStrategic tip:§r

1º if you attack Gariheuz, try to put the bosses together.
2º If you attack Koyomi, split the bosses up.

§e§lTrident Rain§r

Tridents start falling above
every player.

§b§lStrategic tip:§r

1º Don't stop running!

§c§lArcane Globe§r

Koyomi launches an arcane globe and a random player will get Arcane Affinity. This effect allows the player to hit the globe by §eheadbutting§r it, sending it into the air again. If the globe lands, it will blow up, dealing scaling lethal damage to all players and §3weakening§r them for a couple seconds.

§b§lStrategic tip:§r

1º Upon §eheadbutting§r the balloon, it will move towards where you're looking at. If it falls outside the platform you'll regret it!

2º Arcane Affinity changes to a different player when the globe is hit.

3º Hitting the globe grants the player strength IV 12 seconds and speed. Make use of them, Koyomi has a lot of hp!

§e§lMultishot§r

Gariheuz slides and shoots poisoned projectiles in
every direction.

§c§lDracotoxic Arrow§r

Gariheuz slides and shoots 3 lethal projectiles that
follow random players faster and faster.
The arrow only goes away if it collides with the Arcane Shield.

§b§lStrategic tip:§r

1º Intercept the projectile with the Arcane Shield.

§6§lHallucinatory Poison §r§7(Singeplayer)§r

Gariheuz infects you with purple poison and leaves pools of poison. Stepping on a pool changes the color of your poison to the opposite (green or purple). Immediately after, 11 copies of Gariheuz shall spawn. Green poison will make you see 5/11 copies marked with particles, and purple poison will make you see a different 5/11 marked. Only 1/11 isn't marked in either and is the real one, which you must hit. Hitting a wrong copy deals lethal damage to everyone. If you don't find the real one in 75s, You will start taking periodic damage.

§b§lStrategic tip:§r

1º Use the pools to change your poison and discover the real copy.

§6§lHallucinatory Poison §r§7(Multiplayer Version)§r

Gariheuz infects half the players with green poison and the other half with purple poison. Immediately after 11 copies of Gariheuz will spawn. Green players see 5/11 copies marked with particles, and purple players see a different 5/11 marked. Only 1/11 §cis not§r marked in any case and is the real one, which you must hit. Hitting a wrong copy deals lethal damage to everyone. If you don't find the real one in 75s, You will start taking periodic damage.

§b§lStrategic tip:§r

1º Communication between players is key in this phase.

§6§lTridentstorm§r

Only players marked with purple poison can see the entire room covered with white areas that anticipate an imminent barrage of tridents.
Tridents deal §cmuch more damage§f if they hit you
several times.

§b§lStrategic tip:§r

1º If you have purple poison, guide the players with green poison to the safe zone.

b9_info_eothar_0: Maraw'Thar is about to break free, and the power rising within him eclipses even the Conqueror's. Prepare yourselves, your §ctoughest battle§f is coming; you've never faced anything like this.
b9_info_eothar_2: §e▶ §7Wait. Can you explain me what is happening?
b9_info_eothar_3: Unfortunately, I cannot anticipate his moves, only offer some §ebrief§f advice. You're going in §cblind§f to the abilities he'll use.
b9_info_eothar_9:
§b§lAtacrom's Gauntlet (! Important)

§f- Maraw'Thar's attacks deal §cmassive damage§f that §ebreaks§f through any §eimmunity§f or §eresistance§f, but you can §aparry§f them using the §dGauntlet of Atacrom§f! 

- §eYou don't need to eat§f to §dregenerate ❤§f, the gauntlet gives you §esaturation§f for every parry!! 

- Block intelligently, §emissing a parry§f leaves you §cvulnerable§f while the cooldown recovers.

- Make sure §c§leveryone§f has a gauntlet, or speak with Atacrom again at the forge.

§c§lIMPORTANT:§f The attacks that are §b§lBLUE§f in color are infused with primordial dark fire. They §c§lcannot be blocked§f, only §adodged§f!
b9_info_eothar_10:
§b§lMobility (! Important)

§fHaving good mobility and §cteleportation items§f is essential to get out of certain situations! Such as the §dParadoxical Tome§f, §dEo'thar's Scepter§f, or the §dOmegatrident§f! Speak with Koros' memories in the sanctuary to obtain a §dParadoxical Tome§f.
b9_info_eothar_11:
§c§lTime Echoes (§c☠§c§l deadly)

§fSometimes Maraw'Thar will leave echoes of your past selves along your path. If an echo takes damage, §cyou take it as well§f!
b9_info_eothar_12:
§c§lEnrage (§c☠§c§l deadly)

§fIf you haven't defeated the boss at the end of phase III, it will §cenrage§f, §cwiping all players out§f with unblockable attacks. §eOptimize your DPS§f!
b9_info_eothar_14:
§e§lThe Final Challenge 

§fThis boss is §c§lVERY DIFFICULT§f. It isn't meant to be defeated on the first try, but rather to be §emastered through learning its patterns§f. Don't worry if it takes you several attempts, this is the §afinal challenge§f of §5§oFinal Paradox§f!

§7(Given the difficulty of the boss, it is §erecommended to play it solo§7 for better concentration. The boss is §bvery fast§7, and a §egood connection§7 is required to fight it in §emultiplayer§7!)
b9_info_eothar_16:
§b§lPoint of View (! Important)

§fIt is recommended to play this boss fight in §ethird-person view§f (F5). The boss moves very fast and having a wider point of view will help a lot.
b9_info_eothar_17: There isn't much time, so I'll be brief. The Conqueror gained his temporal powers by subjugating §eAphofis§f, the great cosmic serpent, using the knowledge of the §eClocktower§f. The suffering inflicted upon §eAphofis§f was so immense that it gave birth to a temporal nightmare within its mind: §cMaraw'thar§f, a being that embodies suffering itself, and feeds on it.
b9_info_eothar_19: The Conqueror was never truly aware that the real source of his power, and the dark flame with which he planned to purge the galaxy, came directly from §cMaraw'thar§f, not from §eAphofis§f.
b9_info_eothar_21: Now §eAphofis§f is tormented by this nightmare, which is on the verge of becoming real, and unstoppable, unless we stop it right now! Our chances are slim, and I hate to say it, but you are the only silver bullet capable of ending this being.
b9_info_eothar_22: §e▶ §7Why don't you consider us §eheroes§7? Have we done something wrong?
b9_info_eothar_23: By §edefeating the Conqueror§f, you have completely §cfreed Maraw'Thar§f. And now, on top of everything, he wields the power of the cosmic cores within the Conqueror's own body... The situation is desperate. It would have been better if you hadn't played at being heroes and meddled with the timelines! A future with Thar Kroo as leader would have been a paradise compared to what awaits us if this being gets his way. You want to be §eheroes§f? §eThen prove it now§f.
b9_info_eothar_24:
Are you sure you want to start the fight? 
§4§l<!> WARNING <!> §r§cThis boss is tough. It is highly §erecommended§c that you §eread the tips §cbeforehand. §7§o(They are very brief)
b9_info_eothar_26:
§b§lEo'Thar Help (! Important)

§fEo'Thar is greatly weakened, but with her last breath she will grant you §c§lStrength IV§f for the entire encounter. §eUse your sword§f to maximize DPS! Bows and other weapons are not as effective.
